                          Mini Framing in Text

1.  Introduction

   Mini Framing prefixes a run of octets with its length.

2.  Framing

   A sender MUST prefix each frame with its length in one octet.  A
   sender MUST NOT frame more than 255 octets.  A receiver MAY log a
   frame.
